# Wait for address-card rows before using them

waitForCardsListReady asserts that the list exists, skips waiting if isReady, otherwise installs the row-buffer-ready event and waits for it followed by one animation frame. The JSDoc correction to TreeView and caller use align with that concrete readiness contract. Keep readiness and layout as separate waits when changing this helper. No row-buffer or layout execution ran. This is source and test-code inspection. Complete Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline context remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.

Scope: mail/components/addrbook.
